evidence.observation: Stable column profile with slow upward creep of mid-column temps (T703 78.7→79.6 °C), top stays ~67 °C
Reflux ~0.15 L/h, distillate ~0.44 L/h, ratio steady ~6.8 with normal scatter
Differential pressures steady (~0.7 / ~2.0 mbar), system pressure ~598 mbar
Reboiler reads ~401 °C, implausibly high vs column profile — likely sensor scale/offset artifact, otherwise flat

args.missing_evidence: A composition/GC measurement of distillate and bottoms; independent check of T701 calibration to confirm the 401 °C reading is a sensor artifact rather than real
